placeholder: eyJhbGciOi… A Bearer prefix or line breaks are fine
unsigned: Unsigned: the token has no signature
notVerified: Decoded only: the signature is not verified

status.no-expiry: Active, never expires: it has no exp claim
status.invalid: Can’t tell whether it works: {{claim}} is not a NumericDate (seconds since 1970)

claims.title: Times
claims.notDate: Not a NumericDate: a number of seconds since 1970 was expected

errors.whitespace: The token has a space in it: a JWT has none. Paste the token on its own
errors.parts: A JWT has three parts separated by dots: header.payload.signature
errors.encrypted: This is an encrypted token (JWE, five parts): it can’t be read without its key
errors.utf8: The {{part}} does not decode to UTF-8 text
errors.not-object: The {{part}} is JSON but not an object

verify.title: Verify signature
verify.placeholder: Secret, PEM public key or certificate, JWK or JWKS
verify.hint: Paste the key to check the signature. A JWKS is pasted, never fetched from a URL
verify.invalid: Invalid signature: the token was not signed with this key, or was changed after signing

sign.privateKeyPlaceholder: -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- (PKCS#8 PEM) or a private JWK
sign.hint: Paste a key to sign the payload. Use test keys only

jws.key-json: The key starts like JSON but is not valid JSON
jws.key-format: This JSON is neither a JWK (it has no kty) nor a JWKS (it has no keys array)
jws.pem-unsupported: {{detail}} PEM is not supported: convert it to PKCS#8 or SPKI, e.g. openssl pkey -in key.pem
jws.key-mismatch: {{detail}} needs a different kind of key: HS algorithms take a secret, the others a public or private key
jws.key-invalid: This key can’t be used with {{detail}}: check its type, curve and encoding
jws.jwks-no-match: No key in the JWKS fits this token’s kid and alg
jws.jwks-secret: A JWKS holds public keys, not HMAC secrets: paste the secret itself to verify an HS token
jws.jwks-invalid: This JWKS is not valid: each entry in keys must be a JWK
jws.jws-unsupported: This token uses JWS features the Tool doesn’t verify, such as a crit or b64 header
jws.jwks-sign: Paste one private key to sign with, not a JWKS
jws.alg-none: The token is unsigned (alg none): there is no signature to verify
jws.private-needed: Signing needs the private key, not the public one
jws.payload-json: The payload is not valid JSON
jws.payload-not-object: The payload must be a JSON object
